(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix RUM TCO-Policies-List. Behaves like `coralogix_tco_policies_logs` minus dataset routing (`targets`). For more information - https://coralogix.com/docs/tco-optimizer-api."
id  StringAttribute computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to tco-policies-rum
    markdown: "The fixed id of this singleton: there is one per company."
policies  ListNestedAttribute required
policies[]  NestedObject
policies[].applications  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "The applications to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the applications by default."
policies[].applications.names  SetAttribute required elem=basetypes.StringType
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: must not be empty or contain ","
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: must not contain uppercase letters or commas; the backend lowercases these names, and commas are used as the multi-value separator
policies[].applications.rule_type  StringAttribute optional computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to is
    markdown: "The rule type. Can be one of [\"includes\" \"is\" \"is_not\" \"starts_with\" \"unspecified\"]."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["includes" "is" "is_not" "starts_with" "unspecified"]
policies[].archive_retention_id  StringAttribute optional
    description: "Allowing RUM events with a specific retention to be tagged."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
policies[].description  StringAttribute optional computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to 
    markdown: "The policy description"
policies[].dpxl_expression  StringAttribute optional
    markdown: "DataPrime expression to match RUM events for this policy. Mutually exclusive with the structured matchers (`severities`, `applications`, `subsystems`) — set either this or those. The expression must include a version prefix and reference the canonical `$d.*` schema (not `$d.cx_rum.*`), e.g. `<v1> $d.severity == 'Error'`."
    validator: schemavalidator.ConflictsWithValidator Ensure that if an attribute is set, these are not set: "[<.severities,<.applications,<.subsystems]"
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
policies[].enabled  BoolAttribute optional computed
    default: booldefault.staticBoolDefault value defaults to true
    markdown: "Determines weather the policy will be enabled. True by default."
policies[].id  StringAttribute computed
    markdown: "tco-policy ID."
policies[].name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "tco-policy name."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
policies[].order  Int64Attribute computed
    markdown: "The policy's order between the other policies."
policies[].priority  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "The policy priority. Can be one of [\"block\" \"high\" \"low\" \"medium\"]. When `quota_based_priority_override` is set, this is also the fallback priority applied once all `usage_tiers` are exhausted — the equivalent of \"Route the remaining quota to\" in the UI — and must be more restrictive than the last tier's priority (most to least restrictive: `block`, `low`, `medium`, `high`)."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["block" "high" "low" "medium"]
policies[].quota_based_priority_override  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "Dynamically reassign the policy's priority based on daily quota consumption tiers. Once all `usage_tiers` are exhausted, the policy's top-level `priority` is used as the fallback (\"Route the remaining quota to\" in the UI), which must be more restrictive than the last tier."
policies[].quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers  ListNestedAttribute required
    markdown: "Ordered list of quota-consumption tiers; the priority is dynamically reassigned to the matching tier's `priority` once `daily_quota_percentage` is reached."
    validator: listvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator list must contain at least 1 elements
policies[].quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers[]  NestedObject
policies[].quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers[].daily_quota_percentage  Float64Attribute required
    markdown: "Daily quota consumption (in percent) at which this tier becomes active. Must be between 0 and 100."
    validator: float64validator.betweenValidator value must be between 0.000000 and 100.000000
policies[].quota_based_priority_override.usage_tiers[].priority  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "The priority to apply when this tier is active. Can be one of [\"high\" \"low\" \"medium\"] (`block` is not valid for a tier)."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["high" "low" "medium"]
policies[].severities  SetAttribute optional computed elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "The severities to apply the policy on. Valid severities are [\"critical\" \"debug\" \"error\" \"info\" \"verbose\" \"warning\"]. Mutually exclusive with `dpxl_expression` — set exactly one."
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: value must be one of: ["critical" "debug" "error" "info" "verbose" "warning"]
policies[].subsystems  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    markdown: "The subsystems to apply the policy on. Applies the policy on all the subsystems by default."
policies[].subsystems.names  SetAttribute required elem=basetypes.StringType
    validator: setvalidator.sizeAtLeastValidator set must contain at least 1 elements
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: must not be empty or contain ","
    validator: setvalidator.valueStringsAreValidator element value must satisfy all validations: must not contain uppercase letters or commas; the backend lowercases these names, and commas are used as the multi-value separator
policies[].subsystems.rule_type  StringAttribute optional computed
    default: stringdefault.staticStringDefault value defaults to is
    markdown: "The rule type. Can be one of [\"includes\" \"is\" \"is_not\" \"starts_with\" \"unspecified\"]."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["includes" "is" "is_not" "starts_with" "unspecified"]
